verdict.rationale: ADK provides some guardrail mechanisms—Tool Confirmation (HITL) to gate tool execution and Callbacks to hook into execution lifecycle for custom logic/side-effects—but there is no documented fine-grained permission model or sandboxed execution environment for tools/code. missing for 10: explicit tool-permission scoping/allowlisting, sandboxed or isolated code execution environment, and any security-boundary documentation for untrusted tool calls.
